contributions.detail: delta +0.22: the 34 rows sum to 10,438.40 while the attachment's own printed TOTAL, and Summary line 1, both read 10,438.18. Every amount was re-read at 900 dpi in two tight column crops and none changed. THE CAUSE IS VISIBLE IN THE DOCUMENT: the in-kind row is printed as a rounded '$709' in the row but the SAME transaction on the Schedule B attachment is printed '$708.78' - exactly 22 cents less - so the filer's total was computed on 708.78 while the row shows 709. Nothing was adjusted; both figures are retained verbatim.

expenditures.detail: exact (9866.06 = 9,866.06); the 23 rows, including the negative -$190.00 refund row, sum to the attachment's own printed Total $9,866.06 and to Summary line 2

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: No page-subtotal cell is filled: the two FORM pages (p3, p5) carry only a handwritten 'See Attached' and leave SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE and TOTAL blank. Each attachment prints one grand total. p6 (expenditures) GATED EXACTLY at 9,866.06. p4 (contributions) DID NOT GATE: rows 10,438.40 vs printed TOTAL 10,438.18, a 0.22 gap that survived a full 900 dpi re-read of the amount column and is explained above. Both figures are named; no row was adjusted to close it.
itemized.escalation_note: p4 amount+date columns at 900 dpi in two tight crops (rows 1-25 and rows 26-34) after the first pass failed the total by 0.22. Every one of the 34 amounts read identically at 900 dpi, including the small interest-earned figures ($2.96, $0.88, $0.56) and the $45 that were the natural suspects - which is what turned the gap from a transcription doubt into a documented filer discrepancy.
itemized.notes: 6-page filing: p1 cover, p2 Summary Page (totals tranche, not redone), p3 Schedule A form ('See Attached' only), p4 the attached typed 'January 31 Donations Report / Jim Bradley Campaign' (LANDSCAPE - rendered at 300/900 dpi and rotated 90 deg CLOCKWISE; 34 rows + TOTAL), p5 Schedule B form ('See Attached' only), p6 the attached typed 'January 31 Expense Report' (portrait, 23 rows + Total). PRIVACY: the donations attachment prints FullAddress, City, State and Zip columns and all four are empty on every row - that is the source's state, not a redaction, so donor_city/donor_state are blank throughout. The donations attachment splits names into LastName / FirstName columns (joined as printed) and several rows are joint donors ('William and Martha Scott'). Nine occupation cells read 'Requested' - the filer's marker for information asked for but not received, not an occupation. ONE IN-KIND transaction (Ecallogy voice blast) appears on both sides and is the source of the contributions-side 0.22 discrepancy: $709 on the donations sheet, $708.78 on the expense sheet. The expense sheet carries a NEGATIVE row (-$190.00, Valley Journals, 'Refund') which the filer's own total treats as negative, and a $1,170.93 loan repayment to the candidate and his spouse. The clerk listing gives this filing no election year; the form is the January 31 year-end for the 2006 cycle on its face.
